title: ODS packages a local AI server for chat, voice, agents and RAG
friendlyTitle: ODS turns your computer into a private AI server
summary: ODS is an open-source stack for turning a Linux, macOS or Windows machine into a local AI server with model inference, chat, voice, agents, workflows, retrieval and image generation. It includes installer and container options for several hardware paths.
friendlySummary: This open-source package combines local chat, voice, agents, document search and image tools in one setup.
whyItMatters: People who want one self-hosted environment can use ODS to assemble common local-AI services without integrating every component from scratch. Check hardware requirements, exposed ports, model licenses and data backups before deployment.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can save setup time for a home or work AI server, but you should check security and hardware needs first.
